title: ULTRAS
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: An anthology by est em set largely in Europe. In the title story, football fan Leon celebrates a national-team win with drink and wakes up having spent the night with Al, a member of a rival club's ultras supporters' group; later chapters show Leon's grandfather learning about them. Other stories follow a conman and a French pickpocket, a voyeur and the author he watches, a washed-up director and actor reuniting, and a Spaniard in Japan pining for a coworker (AniList, MU).
life_message: Love between men can cross rival loyalties, past failures and borders.
